name: Red Bull Ring
description: A short, quick lap in the Styrian hills. Three hard stops on the climb to the top of the circuit, then a fast, downhill sweep back through the last two right-handers.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (1380 of 1728 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
